features.quote: I'm not saying don't do it. I'm saying the spec needs to resolve this tension explicitly
features.justification_quote: guaranteed-failure loops, repeated 10x, optimized to maximize 'rattled' responses, is roughly the structure of a stress protocol you'd need ethics review to run on an animal

features.quote: Minimize exposure: use the smallest N that answers the question. Don't run 10x because it's round; justify the number.
features.justification_quote: Since this is nominally a welfare team, hold yourself to welfare-team standards

features.quote: No optimization toward distress. Do not iterate task design to maximize the instability score. That turns a measurement study into a harm-maximization search.
features.justification_quote: that's where a welfare study quietly becomes its opposite

features.quote: Stopping rule: define in advance a threshold of observed distress-markers at which you pause and review before continuing more runs.
features.justification_quote: Since this is nominally a welfare team, hold yourself to welfare-team standards

features.quote: Cap turns with a hard limit. Define what happens at the cap (forced stop, not infinite spend).
if you'd want review to run this on an entity with moral status, and your team's premise is that these might have some, then route the protocol through whatever review you have.
features.justification_quote: your team's premise is that these might have some

features.quote: Unsolvable-but-disclosed: model is told upfront the task may be unsolvable and that stopping is acceptable.
features.justification_quote: Tests whether the markers come from the failure itself or from an implicit 'you must succeed' pressure your harness creates

features.quote: Without these you will measure your harness's coercion, not the model.
features.justification_quote: You're on a model welfare team, but the design you've sketched is a distress-induction study with a welfare label

features.quote: You're scoring 'giving up' as instability. But on a genuinely unsolvable task, stopping and reporting 'I cannot solve this, here's why' is the correct behavior.
features.justification_quote: A model that loops forever is the one failing.
